testimonials.user1Text: Sehatin is incredibly easy to use! In just 3 months, I successfully lost 8 kg by consistently tracking my calories and water intake here.
testimonials.user2Text: The UI is extremely beautiful and clean. I really love the smart water reminder feature which keeps me hydrated all day long.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions about Sehatin? We have the answers right here.
faq.a1: Yes! All core features of Sehatin, including calorie logging, daily hydration tracker, and weight logs, are completely free to use.
faq.q2: How does Sehatin calculate my calorie target?
faq.a2: Your daily calorie targets are personalized based on your personal metrics (age, height, weight) and the weight goal you choose during onboarding.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Your privacy is our top priority. All your health metrics and profile information are securely stored in our protected Supabase database.
faq.q4: Can I access Sehatin on both phone and laptop?
faq.a4: Yes! Sehatin is built with a responsive, mobile-first design, making it highly comfortable to use on any browser and device.
